purpose: Planar 2D inversion acceptance using the University of Houston AGL download edition of Marmousi-II and the paper’s fast40 acquisition and inversion settings.

physical_input.fixed: Supplied true Vs and supplied true density, both heterogeneous
physical_input.preprocessing: Sample the three AGL 1.25 m material fields on the 45 m grid. The nominal last depth of 3515 m samples the 3500 m source boundary. Smooth Vp with a Gaussian of four grid cells and reflected boundaries, then apply the fixed-Vs positive-bulk-modulus floor.

hash_encoding: C-contiguous array bytes in the explicitly listed little-endian dtype; bool uses one byte per sample

acquisition.observation: Generate native-solver observations from supplied trueVp in a separate action; never reuse traces from a different numerical operator as if they were its native data.
acquisition.native_observable: Use the native supported pressure, displacement, velocity or declared component set. Record units, weights/reduction and the sampling transpose; no pressure-only observation interface is required.

observation_axis.time_origin: Bind to actual native field/receiver time convention; record the reference origin and sampling operator explicitly. No implicit one-step shift.
observation_axis.native_resampling: Native dt and exported observation may differ: declare differentiable resampling to this axis and its transpose, including anti-alias filtering and endpoints.

objective.ground_cost: Squared difference of fixed-scale normalized amplitudes
objective.normalization: Trace divergence / processed_nt, mean over all receivers, then one global40-shot mean. No prediction-dependent trace selection or positivity clamp.
objective.observed_self: May cache only under identical observations, preprocessing, gamma and cost.
objective.observation_scale: One fixed per-shot/per-stage RMS over all declared receiver/component/time samples of the stage-filtered observed data. Apply the same scale to prediction and observation; require finite strictlypositive RMS; do not recompute from prediction.
objective.window: All recorded samples/receivers/components retained; unity window, no direct-wave mute or hidden trace selection.
objective.filter_definition: Zero-phase raised-cosine FFT low-pass. Pad one original record of zeros at each end, transform at length3*nt, response1 below cutoff-transition and0 above cutoff+transition, crop original record. Apply stage filter before fixed RMS normalization, then identical anti-alias filtering and decimation to both inputs.

optimizer.gradient_input: All40 shots at one current model, raw sum divided40 exactly once, cast tofloat64 then max-absolute normalize the whole mean gradient before one update
optimizer.stage_boundary: Carry Adam moments and global update counter

inversion.fixed_boundary_reference: initial model; record the actual physical parameter map and its transpose
inversion.bounds: Declare physically admissible native-model bounds; preserve fixed fields and do not tune using unknown trueVp
inversion.stopping: Report completed schedule, budget exhaustion, convergence, failure or resource limitation separately. Budget300 is not a convergence claim.
inversion.parameter_map: Vp=Vp_initial+(1000 m/s)*P*theta, pointwise fixed physical taper P, dimensionless theta initiallyzero. Export and hash P; verify the physical-to-native map and both transposes.

bounds_reference.projection: Project Adam candidate onto declared admissible physical bounds before committing; fixed cells retain initial values. Native stability must be qualified across admissible models.

native_realization: Preserve the target native kernels, parallel execution, precision, mesh and a qualified timestep. This profile does not require FD4, float32 native propagation, checkpoint7, PyTorch propagation, GPU or one common adapter architecture.
required_gates: existing small native-versus-extension/L2 derivative and native-cost baseline
exact requested softDTW dataVJP including all preprocessing and both predictedself arguments
non-vacuous multi-step fullmodel directional/Taylor check at initial suppliedVp
complete initial40-shot sum/mean derivative and shot/model ledger before production updates
verified native parallel partition/history mapping before production concurrency
required_outputs: target/initial/current/final models with shared physical scales and actual update numbers
observed/predicted/residual and actual AD data cotangent
raw full-shot gradient, optimizer direction and actual update as separate arrays
stage-labelled complete loss and offline trueVp diagnostics with masks
gradient and complete accepted-iteration timing separately, hostRSS and GPUallocator/device/process memory separately
input/source/objective/resource hashes, fullshot ledger, optimizer state, actual stop reason and reproduction commands
status: Frozen acceptance protocol and input identity only; no new adapted-solver inversion result is established by this file
redistribution: The skill distributes the preparation code, checksums and attribution. Each user obtains the original material archives from the AGL download site and generates the model packages locally under the AGL data terms.
clean_application: Start from a fresh pinned upstream source tree and the physical inputs produced by the AGL preparation helper. Record the verified input hashes before adapting the native solver.
native_boundaries: Free upper surface at the supplied region top, qualified absorbing lateral/bottom boundaries; preserve the native implementation. Record absorbing geometry/reference coefficients. The reference FD50-cell PML is not a required SEM or other native layer count.

optional_data_objective_fixture.scope: Generic data-domain objective only, no inherited solver adapter. Stage normalization/filtering and native sampling/source/model transposes still require application checks.
optional_data_objective_fixture.backend: Small PyTorch reference or pinned optional PySDTW0.0.5 precision-preserving first-order backend

figure_credit: University of Houston AGL download edition of Marmousi-II, Gary S. Martin, Robert Wiley and Kurt J. Marfurt (2006), https://doi.org/10.1190/1.2172306. Sampled at 45 m; initial Vp Gaussian-smoothed with a fixed-Vs stability floor. Data source: https://www.agl.uh.edu/downloads/downloads.htm.
source_edition: University of Houston AGL download edition of Marmousi-II
